properties.description: Built 2026-10-28 (branch reading/owner-ruling-and-supported-given). In crates/reflow2-core/src/inference.rs, `supported_given`: for a reading that would otherwise be conditional, the lightest line resting on evidence (a documented result or a statistical test) and otherwise only on assumptions every step holds as a model or a principle (held_as, #806), with no undischarged supposition, unverified citation, undocumented report or bridge, makes the claim read `supported`: proof_status `supported` with the held premises in `given` and a why naming each ("con:m (held as a model)"); reasoning_report's claim `truth: supported` with `given`; a step's `holds_as` `supported`. Anything else reads as before, and a design that holds nothing as a model or principle reads exactly as before (the readings golden did not move).
properties.name: A claim a documented result supports, resting otherwise only on premises held on purpose, reads supported given them, naming each; never proven
